summary: Session 101 fresh source-and-live audit after the recovered S100 boundary. Six premises survive verification: public ingress returns the SPA shell for worker-owned project APIs; public pulse exposes exact small-cohort behavior and recomputes durable summaries per request; playlist entropy is neither injectable nor reproducible and uses comparator shuffling; certified post-match coaching disappears when remote AI budget is unavailable; compact post-match controls miss the 44px mobile interaction floor; and staging deploy verifies only health/revision rather than product JSON/auth/agent contracts. Production remains NO-GO on external launch evidence.

gameLoop.result: The certified Capture → Convoy → Pressure → Breach → decisive-delivery loop is strong. The sharpest live break is outside simulation: same-origin meta/progression APIs terminate on the master and return HTML, while coaching has no cost-neutral certified baseline. Retention remains evidence-capped until real humans complete the loop.

items.title: Bridge the public master to worker-owned project APIs without SPA fallthrough
items.why: Live staging returns status 200 text/html for /api/leaderboard, /api/clans/leaderboard, /api/tournaments, Prediction League, and Match Oracle. Those handlers exist only on workers while nginx sends unprefixed traffic to Master, whose wildcard route returns index.html.
items.recipe: Add one bounded master proxy before SPA fallback; preserve canonical game-id sharding for match-bound routes, use a stable control-plane shard for globally durable stores, retain headers/status/body limits, fail JSON-503 on upstream loss, and cover routing plus content type. Core-loop step: post-match/meta input → persistent commander-world fantasy → progression/social reward → next match.

L1.recipe: Reject unknown /api routes as JSON rather than HTML.

L2.recipe: Proxy global project APIs to a stable healthy worker.

L3.recipe: Preserve game-id sharding, headers, bounded failures, and direct integration tests.

items.coreLoopStep: post-match/meta input → persistent commander-world fantasy → progression/social reward → next match
executionLog: Added a bounded Master-to-worker API proxy before SPA fallback, with stable control-plane routing, canonical game-id sharding, header/status preservation, JSON 503 failures, and a 15-second upstream timeout.
Covered global, query-bound, body-bound, and path-bound routing plus non-SPA response behavior in WorkerApiProxy tests.

items.title: Publish playtest learning without exposing early-cohort behavior
items.why: The public pulse route exposes exact one-to-four actor/session/event counts, rates, freshness, and recent behavior despite /stats.json declaring a five-person small-count threshold. Master and Worker also duplicate the full durable summary query on every read.
items.recipe: Extract one TTL/single-flight summary service; invalidate after writes; project a public schema that bands one-to-four actors and suppresses rates/timeline/freshness while keeping the authenticated operator view exact. Core-loop step: playtest action → measured loop fantasy → privacy-safe learning reward → tuned next session.

L1.recipe: Remove recent-event timelines from the public response.

L3.recipe: Add shared TTL/single-flight computation, write invalidation, and privacy regression tests.

items.coreLoopStep: playtest action → measured loop fantasy → privacy-safe learning reward → tuned next session
executionLog: Extracted a five-second TTL single-flight summary service with explicit write invalidation in both Master and Worker.
Suppressed one-to-four actor exact counts, rates, freshness, evidence, and timelines from the public projection while preserving a truthful withheld-state client presentation and regression tests.

items.title: Make public playlist randomness injectable, unbiased, and reproducible
items.why: MapPlaylist mixes Math.random, a Date.now seeded generator, and sort(() => random - .5). Tests cannot reproduce a live special lobby, and comparator shuffling is biased.
items.recipe: Inject one entropy source, replace comparator shuffling with Fisher-Yates, route every map/team/modifier roll through it, expose a bounded selection receipt for operator diagnostics, and prove same-seed equality plus different-seed variance. Core-loop step: queue input → surprising fair battlefield fantasy → trusted match reward → replayable tuning.

L2.recipe: Inject all playlist entropy and add deterministic tests.

L3.recipe: Add non-secret selection receipts and distribution sanity proof.

items.coreLoopStep: queue input → surprising fair battlefield fantasy → trusted match reward → replayable tuning
executionLog: Routed all playlist entropy through one injectable validated source and replaced comparator sorting with Fisher-Yates.
Added deterministic same-seed/different-seed tests and a defensive, non-secret SHA-256 selection receipt carrying the bounded operator diagnostics promised by L3.

items.title: Keep certified coaching alive when remote AI is unavailable
items.why: The Coach tab returns 503 and then 'No debrief moments available' whenever the remote budget reservation is unavailable. A certified match therefore loses its learning reward at the exact cost-neutral baseline.
items.recipe: Derive two or three transparent moments from the requester’s certified intent timeline; label them deterministic replay analysis; return them before optional remote enhancement and fall back on provider error/budget denial. Never claim unobserved causality. Core-loop step: certified result → reflective commander fantasy → actionable learning reward → improved rematch.

L1.recipe: Return two certified timeline moments instead of 503.

L2.recipe: Use requester-bound intent phases and transparent heuristic labels.

L3.recipe: Make remote coaching an optional enhancement with cache/receipt and fail-safe local fallback.

items.coreLoopStep: certified result → reflective commander fantasy → actionable learning reward → improved rematch
executionLog: Added requester-bound early/mid/late certified replay moments as a deterministic local baseline that never claims unobserved causality.

Extracted CoachDebriefRouter, made remote generation an optional budgeted enhancement, and retained the local result on budget denial or provider failure while staying inside Worker composition budgets.

items.title: Give post-match and prediction actions a real mobile interaction floor
items.why: AI tabs use py-1, coach uses py-2, several debrief actions use py-0.5/py-1, and Prediction League declares 2.5rem. These important return-loop controls miss the 44px mobile target floor.
items.recipe: Apply one 44px minimum action primitive with visible focus to the touched WinModal, ProgressionDebrief, and Prediction League controls; preserve compact layout; verify all themes at desktop and mobile. Core-loop step: result input → readable reward fantasy → confident next-action reward → continued session.

L2.recipe: Cover tabs, secondary actions, focus-visible, and Prediction League.

L3.recipe: Add measured mobile browser proof across every theme and touched state.

items.coreLoopStep: result input → readable reward fantasy → confident next-action reward → continued session
executionLog: Raised touched postmatch, progression, coach, story, share, and Prediction League actions to a 44px minimum target with visible keyboard focus.
Added the live prediction-league proof state and passed the regenerated 120-artifact desktop/mobile matrix across VaultFront, Light, and Competitive themes with a fresh hash-bound receipt.

items.title: Make staging prove product contracts, not only process health
items.why: Deploy verifies /_health and /commit.txt. It did not notice that project API requests returned the SPA document with 200. Obelisk and dual-audience files are likewise outside the exact-revision attestation.
items.recipe: Add a reusable origin smoke script that checks JSON content types/statuses for public and unauthenticated project routes, Obelisk redirect host and cookie posture, agents/llms availability, revision, and health; run it before attestation and attach its JSON receipt. Core-loop step: release input → trustworthy live-game fantasy → verified playable reward → safe Alpha iteration.

L1.recipe: Assert pulse JSON and reject HTML API fallthrough.

L2.recipe: Cover auth redirect, agent files, health, and revision.

L3.recipe: Emit and upload a hash-bound product smoke receipt in staging deploy.

items.coreLoopStep: release input → trustworthy live-game fantasy → verified playable reward → safe Alpha iteration
executionLog: Added an exact-revision origin smoke for health, revision, privacy-safe pulse JSON, worker API non-SPA behavior, Obelisk unauthenticated/PKCE posture, and both agent-facing files.
Placed the smoke before staging attestation, uploaded its self-digested receipt, and bound that receipt into the run attestation so process health can no longer mask product-contract failure.

L2.recipe: Render a theme-aware homepage pulse from the same feed with stale/unavailable states.

executionLog: Upgraded the descriptor to Analytica Feed v1 with project identity, a one-day poll contract, aggregate-only privacy, a curated three-metric showcase, and six deeply defined metrics.

Added a theme-aware homepage Alpha Pulse that reads only the shared static feed, labels unavailable and stale truth explicitly, and links into the deeper stats analysis; CANON-054 now conforms with zero findings.

items.title: Run CI on the runtime floor the locked dependency graph actually supports
items.why: Exact-revision CI exposed intersecting sanitize-html Node >=22.12 and ESLint Node >=22.13 engine contracts while the repository still advertised and ran Node 20.
items.recipe: Raise the repository engine floor and every core CI/brief job to one exact supported Node 22.13 runtime, retain the Node 24 production image, and verify workflow contracts.

L1.recipe: Rerun the failed job without changing its unsupported runtime.

L2.recipe: Upgrade only the failing test job.

L3.recipe: Align package engines and every CI consumer on an exact supported floor.
